title: Pushforward $g_*$ along base change
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category and $g\colon Z\to Y$ an arbitrary
morphism of schemes. Base change $V\mapsto V\times_YZ$ is a functor
$Y_{\mathrm{proét}}\to Z_{\mathrm{proét}}$ of small pro-étale sites
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and it is continuous. The *pushforward*

$$
g_*\colon\Sh(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A),
\qquad (g_*G)(V):=G(V\times_YZ),
$$

is restriction of sheaves along base change.

proof.text:
A weakly étale $V\to Y$ base changes to a weakly étale $V\times_YZ\to Z$, so base change
is a functor of sites. It sends covering families to covering families, since pro-étale
covers (fpqc covers by weakly étale maps) are stable under base change. It preserves
finite limits, which exist in the slice $Y_{\mathrm{proét}}$, so it is representably flat
and preserves compatible families. Hence it is continuous, and $g_*G$ is a sheaf for every
sheaf $G$.
